intro: Seven years building games in Unreal Engine and Unity. Now writing renderers from the ground up: a Vulkan 1.3 engine in C++20, plus PBR and stylized rendering in OpenGL.

stats.label: engine stacks: Unreal, Unity, my own

about: I started making games as a hobby in my second year of college. By my third year I was freelancing on Upwork, building games in Unity for clients.

At Pole To Win I moved from Unity to Unreal Engine, delivered a solo trial game, then joined a four-developer team building a multiplayer game for Android and iOS in Unreal and C++. I also onboarded and mentored engineers and technical artists who were new to Unreal.

I studied Computer Games Engineering at Newcastle University, where rendering became my focus. Most of my time now goes below the engine layer: Vulkan and OpenGL renderers, GPU synchronisation, and the architecture that keeps them maintainable.
